name: hotmart-mcp
description: Hotmart (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, get_sales_stats, list_refunds, r

platform_mcp_hotmart_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HOTMART_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_hotmart_client_id.description: Client ID from Hotmart Tools > Developer Credentials.

platform_mcp_hotmart_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HOTMART_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_hotmart_client_secret.description: Client Secret from the same credential.

platform_mcp_hotmart_basic_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HOTMART_BASIC_TOKEN
platform_mcp_hotmart_basic_token.description: The 'Basic' value shown with the credential (without the 'Basic ' prefix).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /user/api/v1/me: the account (id, name, email, ucode, locale, currency_code_commission, time_zone).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /products/api/v1/products: max_results ('Default value for this endpoint is 50'), page_token = the previous page_info.next_page_token (pass next_cursor back as cursor; page is not used), status one of DRAFT, ACTIVE, PAUSED, NOT_APPROVED, IN_REVIEW, DELETED, CHANGES_PENDING_ON_PRODUCT. Products carry no price (prices live in offers/plans); ucode, format, is_subscription and warranty_period are in raw; created_at (epoch ms) stays in raw because the output field is a string.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The product list filtered by id ('Unique identifier (ID) of the product (7-digit number)'); an unknown id returns no record (invalid_input).

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /payments/api/v1/sales/history: start_date in epoch ms from since; 'if you do not set up the transaction or transaction_status filters for this endpoint, it'll only return the "APPROVED" and "COMPLETE" statuses'. id is the transaction code (use it with refund); amount is purchase.price.value in major units ('Total amount paid by the buyer, including taxes and interest'); the order date (purchase.order_date, epoch ms) stays in raw. Pass next_cursor back as cursor.

tools.name: get_sales_stats
tools.description: GET /payments/api/v1/sales/summary 'displays the total commission values per currency' for APPROVED and COMPLETE sales in the window (start_date / end_date epoch ms). revenue / currency / sales are the FIRST currency bucket (items[0]: total_value, total_items = 'Number of commissions paid'); other currencies are in raw.items. refunds is not reported.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: Sales history filtered to transaction_status=REFUNDED (PARTIALLY_REFUNDED and CHARGEBACK are separate statuses, not included). Hotmart has no refund object, so id and sale_id are both the transaction code; since filters by order date; purchase.order_date (epoch ms) is in raw.

tools.name: refund
tools.description: PUT /payments/api/v1/sales/{transaction_code}/refund refunds the whole sale; 'The return from this route is empty. Consider only HTTP codes.' Only Approved/Completed, non-trial, non-BACS/SEPA sales qualify. amount and reason are not sent (no partial refunds).
